king info is sent by email or SMS once your order has been dispatched — be sure to check your spam folder.

UK orders placed before 12 pm get next-day delivery.
European and North American orders typically arrive within 5-15 working days.
Australia orders take 7-20 working days.
Other international destinations may take 30+ working days.
Shipping costs and times can vary, and there might be delays due to carriers or customs. Thanks for your patience!
